title: Transportation occupancy codes
text:
Transportation occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following
 transportation occupancy class codes.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

Note:
 The associated 2-digit Standard Industrial
 Classification (SIC) code or codes are listed for each occupancy code.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 351 | Highway | 41, 42 | Establishments primarily engaged in furnishing highway passenger
 transportation, and establishments furnishing highway passenger terminal or
 maintenance facilities. |
| 352 | Railroad | 40 | Includes establishments furnishing transportation by line-haul railroad,
 as well as switching and terminal establishments. |
| 353 | Air | 45 | Establishments furnishing services incidental to transportation, such as
 forwarding and packing services, as well as the arrangement of passenger and
 freight transportation. |
| 354 | Sea and Inland Waterways | 44 | Businesses engaged in freight and passenger transportation on the open
 seas or inland waters and establishments furnishing such incidental services
 as lighterage, towing, and canal operation. Also includes excursion and
 sightseeing boats and water taxis. |
| 355 | Aircraft Hangars | n/a | Aircraft parking facilities. Valid for exposures in the U.S., Australia,
 Canada, South America, the Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan,
 and for exposures covered for wind in Europe. In other regions, use
 transportation occupancy code 353 (Air) for aircraft hangars. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand . |
| 356 | Aircraft
 at
 Ramps/Gate | n/a | Aircraft at ramps or boarding gates. Valid for exposures in Japan. To be
 used with 246 (Trains,
 Trucks, Airplanes) for the Earthquake-Fire Following model. |

rows:
Establishments primarily engaged in furnishing highway passenger
                        transportation, and establishments furnishing highway passenger terminal or
                        maintenance facilities.

Includes establishments furnishing transportation by line-haul railroad,
                        as well as switching and terminal establishments.

Establishments furnishing services incidental to transportation, such as
                        forwarding and packing services, as well as the arrangement of passenger and
                        freight transportation.

Businesses engaged in freight and passenger transportation on the open
                        seas or inland waters and establishments furnishing such incidental services
                        as lighterage, towing, and canal operation. Also includes excursion and
                        sightseeing boats and water taxis.

Aircraft parking facilities. Valid for exposures in the U.S., Australia,
                        Canada, South America, the Caribbean, Japan, South Korea, China, and Taiwan,
                        and for exposures covered for wind in Europe. In other regions, use
                        transportation occupancy code 353 (Air) for aircraft hangars. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand .

Aircraft at ramps or boarding gates. Valid for exposures in Japan. To be
                        used with 246 (Trains,
                           Trucks, Airplanes) for the Earthquake-Fire Following model.
